lines.zh: 我轻手轻脚地穿过林地。
lines.en: I pass through the woodland softly.

lines.zh: 我的裙角不碰到一根草。
lines.en: My hem doesn't touch a single blade.
I move between the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像在找什么。
lines.en: I walk slowly, as if looking for something.
My footsteps leave no sound.

lines.zh: 我从你的视野外侧过去。
lines.en: I pass along the edge of your vision.

lines.zh: 我回头看了看那条小路。
lines.en: I glance back down the little path.
I shift along close to the trunk.
I stop on the forest path.
I come near, then turn aside.
My hair spreads in the wind.
I walk step by step, as if counting.
I stand behind the tree, watching you.
My smile isn't quite right.
I hold still, waiting for you to come.
My eyes are very dark.
I've waited in these woods a long while.
My fingers haven't stopped moving.
I tilt my head and listen to the wind.
I crush a leaf in my hand.

lines.zh: 没有人来的时候，我很安静。
lines.en: When nobody comes, I'm very quiet.
I'm deciding what to say first.
I smile slowly.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身子大。
lines.en: My shadow is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我拢了拢散下来的头发。
lines.en: I gather my loose hair back.

lines.zh: 我在等一个走错路的人。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to take a wrong turn.

lines.zh: 我把裙角藏在树干后面。
lines.en: I tuck the hem of my dress behind the trunk.
I haven't moved; only watched.

lines.zh: 没人带你，是你自己来的。
lines.en: Nobody brought you; you came yourself.
Few people take this path.

lines.zh: 我在这儿候了你许多天。
lines.en: I've waited here for you many days.
Don't look at me like that; I'll blush.
Are you lost?
I've always lived here.

lines.zh: 你衣服上的铁腥，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the iron on your clothes.
I could show you the way out.
Try trusting me once.
Don't stand in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 你的手指头在轻轻打颤。
lines.en: Your fingertips are trembling faintly.
I don't often meet the living.
You must be tired from walking.
We can talk right here.
I retreat into the tree shadow.
My smile vanished.
I clutch my side and take a step back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我认真起来了。
lines.en: That made me serious.
My hair has come loose.
I answer with a low sound.
I'm not smiling anymore.
I grip my hem and my knuckles go white.
You're harder to handle than I thought.
When you've forgotten me, I'll appear again.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西真有意思。
lines.en: What you're holding is interesting.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我喜欢你的手。
lines.en: I'm not hungry, but I like your hands.
Put it down.
This smells strange.
Eat a bite first, and let me watch.
I can't eat this; keep it.

lines.zh: 你递过来的那些我不敢接。
lines.en: I don't dare take what you hold out.
Not enough to fill a corner.
Let it fall to the ground.
Come a little closer first.
You touched me and I didn't shrink away.
My body is very cold.

lines.zh: 你的手臂碰着我的袖子。
lines.en: Your arm is against my sleeve.
I step back half a pace and return.
You stepped on my hem.
I hold your arm.
You hardly used any force.
I didn't give an inch.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，站在你侧面。
lines.en: I turn and stand at your flank.
My fingers are on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这林子里，再没有第二个。
lines.en: There is no second one in this wood.
Other voices come at night.
We never appear together.
Those are all my shadows.
I don't remember anyone keeping me company.
It's cold under the trees, and I'm alone.
I made up a name for myself.
I get by on my own well enough.
They come quickly and go quickly.

lines.zh: 我等的人，今天总算来了。
lines.en: The one I waited for has come at last.
I pick up a fallen leaf.
I want to keep this.
I slip it into my sleeve.
Your things fell here.
I pick it up slowly and hand it to you.
It's already withered.
I hold it between my fingers.
What I take, I never give back.
This is nice.
Do you want it back?
You've gone too far in.
Go on and it only gets darker.
Thinking of turning back now?

lines.zh: 你喊一声，也不会有人应。
lines.en: Call out; nothing will answer.
My voice stays soft.
The shadows will keep you here for me.
I'm already standing ahead of you.
This wood is mine.
No need to be afraid; it's quick.
You can't see me now, can you?
When I reach you, I'll act.

lines.zh: 你踏进林子那刻，我就跟上了。
lines.en: From the moment you stepped into the wood, I followed.
Your breathing has gone ragged.
Then let it be right here.
I move with the tree shadows.
Every few steps you look back.
No hurry; there's no one else here.

lines.zh: 你的脚印留在我看得见的地方。
lines.en: Your prints stay where I can see them.

lines.zh: 我挪到那棵老橡树后面。
lines.en: I slip behind that old oak.

lines.zh: 我在等你走到那棵枯树。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to reach that dead tree.
Your lamp is useless in daylight.
I stay on your right side.

lines.zh: 你说的每一句我都听见了。
lines.en: I heard every word you said.
You've started to doubt yourself.
Open ground lies just ahead.
I'm waiting for you to step into it.
This wood is larger than you think.

lines.zh: 你兜了半圈，还是回到这里。
lines.en: You circled wide and still came back here.
I know that tree behind you.
I reach out and touch your face.
Your shoulder went cold.
I barely used any force.
A root caught you as you backed away.
My fingers are sharp.
I speak close to your ear.
You won't find a wound from that.
I soften my steps and withdraw into the trees.
You've backed against a trunk.
I laugh aloud, then cut it off.
I step out from behind the tree.
These woods are always quiet.
I'm waiting for someone to pass.
My smile appears first.
The shadows cover me.
I heard footsteps, so I came.
The flowers bloom well here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从影子里显出来。
lines.en: I slowly come out of the shadow.
I stretch my arms out, then let them fall.
It's been a long while since I saw anyone.

lines.zh: 一片枯叶被风吹上我的裙。
lines.en: A dead leaf blows onto my skirt.
I'm here, watching you.
I fold my hands inside my sleeves.
The fruit on the trees is ripe.

lines.zh: 火光里我的影子被拉长。
lines.en: In the firelight my shadow stretches long.
I fall down the slope and my hem tears.
Water floods my throat and I can't hold on.

lines.zh: 爆风把林子的叶子都掀光了。
lines.en: The blast strips the leaves off the trees.

lines.zh: 箭头从我肩下穿了过去。
lines.en: The arrowhead passes under my shoulder.
Light pins me where I stand.
It's been a long time since I ate properly.
Lightning lights up the whole wood.
There are no trees to hide behind here.
